names.ja: マランタ・レウコネウラ

light.best.quote: When grown indoors, place in bright, indirect light.

light.min.quote: This plant tolerates low to medium light.

light.directSun.quote: It is intolerant of direct sunlight or low humidity.

temperature.minC.quote: It is also intolerant of low temperatures or cold drafts.

temperature.minC.reason: 出典に最低温度の記載がないため、熱帯原産の観葉植物の一般的な安全域として10℃とした

temperature.idealC.reason: 出典に数値の記載がないため、熱帯原産の観葉植物が成長する一般的な室温の範囲とした

watering.growing.quote: Keep potting soil evenly moist throughout the growing season

watering.winter.quote: hold back on watering to allow the soil to dry out in the winter months

tips.ja: 日が強すぎると葉の模様が色あせる。
tips.quote: Too much sun will bleach out the attractive leaves colors.

tips.ja: フッ素や肥料のやりすぎで葉が焼ける。
tips.quote: Leaves will burn with high fluorides and with over-fertilization.
